lessons.who: MarketSync platform owners and authorized MarketSync staff. Dealership users cannot access this internal workspace.
before: A signed-in MarketSync account in the correct workspace
A real training record or approved test record to work with

steps.title: Open the right record
steps.body: Open MarketSync OS → Operating Checklists and confirm period, owner, system status, prior exceptions, and due items.

steps.title: Verify the starting information
steps.body: Complete daily health, failed jobs, support, security, billing failure, trial, onboarding, churn-risk, and follow-up checks.

steps.title: Complete the main action
steps.body: Complete weekly funnel, usage, deliverability, integration, incident action, product adoption, capacity, and customer-risk reviews.

steps.title: Review the result
steps.body: Complete monthly MRR, churn, revenue reconciliation, affiliate, costs, access review, backups, compliance, and close evidence.

steps.title: Finish and document
steps.body: Assign every exception, obtain required review, close the period, and carry only documented owned work forward.

lessons.success: Platform operations are reviewed on cadence and every unresolved risk has one owner and deadline.
automatic: MarketSync recalculates internal account and revenue views from the saved SaaS data.
Cross-customer actions remain restricted to authorized MarketSync staff.
problems: DealerOS appears: switch to MarketSync OS and confirm the purple platform identity.
An account is missing: clear filters and search by dealership, contact, or email.
lessons.safety: A completed checklist is evidence of performed verification, not a box-ticking substitute for source review.
